savingsVsYCheaper: Today costs ≈ {pct}% less than yesterday by this hour
savingsVsYText: Closed hours since midnight: today {today}, yesterday over the same hours {yesterday}.
savingsBaseText: This is drawn even in the quietest hour. Check standby devices and always-on loads.
savingsEmpty: Tips will appear once enough data is collected and a tariff is set.
savingsFootnote: “≈” marks an estimate at the device's current tariff rates.
colTrendHint: Power since this page was opened
savingsForecastTextEnergy: At the pace of {elapsed} of {days} days.
savingsVsYDearerEnergy: Today uses ≈ {pct}% more than yesterday by this hour
savingsVsYCheaperEnergy: Today uses ≈ {pct}% less than yesterday by this hour
savingsVsYTextEnergy: Closed hours since midnight: today {today}, yesterday over the same hours {yesterday}.
savingsBaseTitleEnergy: Base load ≈ {power} — that is ≈ {energy} a month
savingsFootnoteEnergy: “≈” marks an estimate at the current pace.
balanceEstimate: ≈ assuming balance: one phase of a multi-phase line is measured; full power = its reading × the number of phases
exportWithoutSource: The input reads export to the grid, but there is no generation or storage on site. Most likely the input current sensor is mounted reversed or the point has a wrong role — contact your installer.
phaseSignMismatch: The phases’ power sign disagrees with the input total — check the direction of the phase current sensors.
solarTodaySelf: The house used {energy} itself — {money} not bought from the grid.
phasesCoverage: The lines cover {pct} % of the input — phase load is understated. Exact with a U3I3 on the input.
phaseLowerBound: at least: the lines don’t see everything
surplusTitle: Surplus is going to the grid now: {power}
surplusText: The best time to run the water heater, laundry or charging — the energy is your own.
surplusGain: For each such hour, the difference between the buy and sell price of this energy is ≈ {money}.
staleRow: no new data for {s} s — the last value is shown
vampTitle: Standby use ≈ {power} round the clock — ≈ {energy} a month
vampRise: It rose by ≈ {power} over the last nights — a new device on standby?
vampText: Devices on standby and always-on loads: router, set-top boxes, chargers, power supplies. Switch off what you don't need and this amount drops.
vampCollecting: Standby use: collecting data — {n} of 3 nights
vampCollectingText: The estimate from the 01:00–05:00 hours appears after a few nights.
savingsForecastTextData: The hub has data since {date} — {elapsed} days, extended to the whole month; excluding standing charges, at current rates. It gets more accurate over the next days.
savingsForecastTextDataEnergy: The hub has data since {date} — {elapsed} days, extended to the whole month. It gets more accurate over the next days.
limitBelowBreaker: The input limit {limit} is well below what the breaker passes ({breaker}). Intended (a contracted capacity) or a single-phase figure?
chartNoLink: Couldn’t load the hours — no connection to the hub.
phaseSeq_reverse: Phase rotation reversed (L1 → L3 → L2): three-phase motors and pumps will turn backwards.
phaseSeq_abnormal: The phases aren't 120° apart — a phase looks missing or wired to the wrong place. Check the input.
phaseImbalanceLow: Current unbalance is assessed from 1 A per phase — below that a single lamp swings the percentage.
savingsDearTextInd: Flexible loads (heating, charging, batches without a fixed schedule) are cheaper to run in the “{cheapest}” zone
surplusTextInd: A good time for flexible loads — the energy is your own.
vampTitleInd: Base load outside working hours ≈ {power} — ≈ {energy} a month
vampTextInd: Equipment on standby, lighting, ventilation and server load outside working hours. Check what can be switched off on a schedule.
vampCollectingInd: Base load: collecting data — {n} of 3 nights
vampCollectingTextInd: An estimate from the 01:00–05:00 hours will appear after a few nights.
todayClockNotSet: The hub's clock isn't set: “today” counts from its own last midnight or restart, not your calendar day.
vampHuntOnly: Standby use: find devices on standby
vampHuntOnlyText: The night-time background estimate appears after a few nights; you can find devices right now from the live power.
savingsForecastSoon: The hub has data only since today. The month forecast appears after the first full day.
savingsLost: No connection to the hub — tips return with the connection.
tariffNoLink: No connection to the hub — the tariff shows once it is back.
placeholderTariff: Money is counted by the factory example tariff, not yours.
ctClipRow: current clipped by the sensor ({pct} % of rating) · under-metered
ctWarnRow: near the sensor limit ({pct} % of rating)
noChannel: no such channel on the module
evDearText: The same energy in the “{cheapest}” zone would have cost ≈ {money} less — at the plan’s rates for the energy actually used.
vampExcluding: Not counted: {names} — they run on their own schedule.
